Welcome to the AI WorkMate planning call for local meeting analysis.
The product name is AI WorkMate, with WorkMate as one word.
Decision one. We keep analysis LOCAL_ONLY on Windows. Local only means no cloud provider, and no transcript content leaves the machine.
Decision two. DATA_ROOT remains on the user's machine. The data root folder stays local. We do not move meeting files out of the data root.
Decision three. We ship Windows real-AI verification before we add a larger instruct model.
